name_disambiguation: Drenthe province, municipality and settlement are distinct units; an employer office does not locate every group vacancy.
CBS suffixes and municipality membership are retained. Zuidwolde, Echten, Alteveer and Vledderveen require municipality/address disambiguation.
A municipality-only employer record is not used to infer a vacancy city.
limitations: CBS annual BAG snapshot at 1 January 2026, provisional; not live boundary geometry.
Search variants are normalisations, not alternative statutory names.
A complete geographic frame does not establish a complete employer census.
